Subject: RE: Private cluster deployment — site readiness & BOM request

Hi all — following up with the technical items we need to lock for the BOM and acceptance criteria. I’ve included the main decision points inline so procurement can see what will be delivered.

1) Node classes (suggested):
- ctrl-1 (2x CPU, 32GB) x3 (control plane, HA) — 2 RU each, 750W per host (nominal)
- infra-1 (4x CPU, 64GB) x3 (logging/monitoring/registry) — 2 RU each, 800W
- gpu-4 (4x A100/4090-class) x8 (inference pool) — 4 RU each, 1600W per host (depends on GPU spec)
- storage-edge (NVMe local cache) x6 — 2 RU each, 900W

2) Storage topology (high level):
- Ephemeral tokens/cache: local NVMe per GPU host — LVM or filesystem-level caching (recommend ext4/XFS with discard disabled)
- Persistent model artifacts: blockstore over iSCSI/FC to SAN (encrypted at rest). We recommend 2x 10Gbps iSCSI paths per host or multipath FC.
- Backups and snapshots: weekly snapshot schedule to remote object store (S3-compatible) and daily lightweight metadata snapshot for rapid rollback.

3) Network & routing:
- Egress: we need a single NAT egress IP range (to allow firewall whitelisting) and BGP peering is optional.
- MTU: confirm 9000 for RDMA/NVMe over Fabrics where applicable
- NTP/DNS: provision internal NTP and a resolvable internal DNS entry space (cluster.local)

4) Security & keys:
- KMS integration: customer-managed key via KMIP or Cloud KMS is required for encryption of secrets
- HSM: optional, call out if procurement wants FIPS-level HSMs

5) Acceptance criteria (draft):
- All nodes reachable via IPMI/SSH and power-tested
- Kubernetes control-plane healthy at 3 master nodes for 48 hours under load test
- Snapshot restore validated for a 2GB model artifact (time < 10 minutes)
- Networking: egress NAT works and 95th percentile latency < 50ms to our control plane region

Questions for Blue Horizon (please answer on call or email):
- Confirm expected GPU model and whether GPUs are pre-installed by vendor
- Confirm power per rack (208V/30A vs 208V/60A PDUs)
- Any air-gapped constraints for OS/package installs?

I’ll draft an itemized BOM (redwood-bom-draft.xlsx) after we confirm GPU SKU and PDU sizing.

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-bom-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below and attached a revised rack layout (rack-plan-v2.pdf).

- GPU model: We plan to supply servers with NVMe and 2x A40-class cards (expected SKU confirmed with vendor).
- Power: Facility provides 208V/60A PDUs per rack. We can allocate 2 PDUs per Redwood rack.
- Air-gap: Not fully air-gapped; outbound access allowed only to specific IP ranges and our internal S3 endpoint.

Procurement timeline: we must have final BOM by EoD 10/08. Please include RU, PDU port count, nominal W, and any vendor part numbers you expect us to procure (we prefer explicit SKUs).

Subject: Deployment phases, SOW pointer and acceptance checklist (internal)

Team — internal draft for the deployment phases and acceptance checklist. Please review and flag anything I missed before we send to Aisha.

Phases:
- Phase 0 (Pre-procurement): validate rack elevations, confirm PDU mapping and IP plan
- Phase 1 (Hardware install & connectivity): racked hardware, IPMI access validated, storage fabric attached
- Phase 2 (Staging): install K8s control plane, join gpu nodes, deploy logging/monitoring; run load test for 48h
- Phase 3 (Limited prod): shadow traffic, model deploy to subset of GPUs, SLA smoke tests
- Phase 4 (Full prod): cutover and handover docs; backup schedules enabled

Key acceptance items (draft):
- Power test: sustained 75% draw per rack for 1 hour without tripping breakers
- Control plane: 3/3 masters stable under simulated node churn for 24h
- Storage: restore a 5GB model artifact from snapshots in <12 minutes
- Networking: BGP not required — but NAT egress + static firewall rules must be validated

SOW/Contract: Monica, please prepare routing for SOW and attach the vendor-friendly BOM. I’ll add the technical annex to the SOW (reference DH-2027-1198). DocuSign draft link: https://docusign.com/XYZ-Redwood-BH-SOW

Karthik
